# Akram El Assas

> Senior Software Engineer. Creator and maintainer of open-source software across .NET, C#, PowerShell, Node.js, TypeScript, React, and React Native.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wexdev.com/): Overview, open-source projects, books, and acknowledgments.
- [Contact](https://wexdev.com/contact/): Contact details and direct inquiries.

## Open-Source Projects

- [Servy](https://servy-win.github.io/): Enterprise-grade Windows service wrapper.
- [Wexflow](https://wexflow.github.io/): Workflow automation engine.
- [BookCars](https://bookcars.github.io/): Car rental platform with mobile app.
- [Movin' In](https://movin-in.github.io/): Rental property management platform with mobile app.
- [wexCommerce](https://wexcommerce.github.io/): Single-vendor marketplace.

## Books

- [Light of Truth (English - PDF)](https://2ly.link/27oLb): Explores worldviews and theories about the universe and existence through logical reasoning.
- [Lumières de vérités (Français - PDF)](https://2ly.link/27oLd): Explore différentes conceptions du monde et théories sur l'origine de l'univers et la nature de l'existence.
